cpu.title: CPU
cpu.description: Name of the processor, for example AMD Ryzen 7 9700X.

motherboard.title: Motherboard
motherboard.description: Name of the motherboard. Exact names we hold maker data for fill in their RAM type and form.

gpu.title: Graphics card
gpu.description: Name of the graphics card. For RTX 5070 Ti models we hold, the maker's length and recommended PSU are filled in.
gpu.prefill: MSI GeForce RTX 5070 Ti 16G GAMING TRIO OC

case.title: Case
case.description: Name of the case. Exact names we hold maker data for fill in their cooler clearance.

cooler.title: CPU cooler
cooler.description: Name of the CPU cooler. Exact names we hold maker data for fill in their height and sockets.

cpuSocket.title: CPU socket
cpuSocket.description: Leave empty if unknown; that check then comes back uncertain.
cpuSocket.sectionCaption: Specs you know (optional: leave a field empty when you are not sure)

cpuVendor.title: CPU maker
cpuVendor.description: Used to estimate CPU power for the PSU check.

cpuTdpW.title: CPU TDP
cpuTdpW.description: The CPU's rated TDP in watts, for the PSU check.

boardMemorySlots.title: Motherboard RAM slots
boardMemorySlots.description: Number of RAM slots on the board.

memoryModules.title: RAM sticks
memoryModules.description: Number of RAM modules in the kit.

gpuLengthMm.title: Graphics card length
gpuLengthMm.description: Only needed when we do not hold the card's maker length.

psu16pin.title: PSU 16-pin (12V-2x6) cables
psu16pin.description: Native 16-pin GPU power cables on the PSU.

psu8pin.title: PSU 8-pin PCIe cables
psu8pin.description: 8-pin PCIe GPU power cables on the PSU.

caseMaxGpuLengthMm.title: Case GPU clearance
caseMaxGpuLengthMm.description: Longest graphics card the case takes.

caseMaxCoolerHeightMm.title: Case cooler clearance
caseMaxCoolerHeightMm.description: Tallest CPU air cooler the case takes. Only needed when we do not hold the case.

caseBoardSizes.title: Case motherboard sizes
caseBoardSizes.description: Board form factors the case takes, one per line.

casePsuSizes.title: Case power supply sizes
casePsuSizes.description: PSU form factors the case takes, one per line.

coolerHeightMm.title: Cooler height
coolerHeightMm.description: Only needed when we do not hold the cooler's maker height.

parts.title: Build as JSON (advanced)
parts.sectionCaption: Advanced: JSON input and many builds
parts.description: Optional. The same build as an object of parts ({cpu: {name, socket, ...}, ...}; field names in the README). Overrides the form fields for any part it names.

builds.title: Batch: many builds
builds.description: Optional. A list of {id, parts} objects, each checked as its own build.
